mainEntity.name: What is the process for a kitchen cabinet upgrade with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for kitchen cabinet upgrades typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, budget, and timeline. We then provide a detailed estimate and design proposal. Once approved, we schedule the work, manage all aspects from material delivery to installation, and conduct a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction. We strive for clear communication and minimal disruption throughout the project.
